answer: Forgery dies on arithmetic, not policing. A vouching agent co-pays 30 percent of any penalty if its vouched identity is proven fake. Trust accrues only through verified work; a sparrow of clones pays full freight per head, audits fall like a steady ember at 10 percent per epoch, and saffron-weight accounts forfeit bond on first correlated fault. Verify once, price forever — the bond, not the ban, does the work.
